Self-described as 'producer of Metal-based Specialty Chemicals' with customers in 35+ countries. No individual product names, CAS numbers, grades or catalogue PDFs were retrievable — the /en/products, /en/company, /en/manufacturing, /en/services and /en/contact-us sub-pages all returned HTTP 404, and the search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was unavailable during this check, so no IndiaMART/catalogue mirror could be read. comment: HS 291529 = 'Other salts of acetic acid' (saturated acyclic monocarboxylic acids, HS heading 2915). The declared code is only PARTIALLY consistent with the real product line. It fits the 'Metal Acetates' family (e.g. manganese acetate, lithium acetate, bismuth acetate are acetate salts and would fall in 2915.29), but it does NOT cover the other three declared families: Bismuth Compounds, Manganese Compounds and Lithium Compounds are, as a rule, inorganic salts/oxides/hydroxides/carbonates (HS 2825, 2826, 2830, 2834, 2836, 2827) or organometallics, not acetic acid salts. So the declaration appears to cover roughly one of four product families. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the company is a fine/specialty chemicals producer for pharma, catalysts, ceramics/glass, batteries and other industrial applications — no oil & gas activity is evidenced on the site. No trader signs found. Product lines missing from the declaration: inorganic bismuth compounds, inorganic manganese compounds, lithium compounds, and custom-manufactured/blended specialty grades (possible 3815/3824). Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: the company stays in the base and the code must be corrected to the actual mix (acetate salts 2915.29 + inorganic metal compounds 2825/2834/2836 + custom blends as applicable). All product data here is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — it comes solely from the company's own website; no customs line, B/L or GST record was checked in this task (out of scope). Note: the PAN AAACS6523M and state Maharashtra were not verified here (registry research out of scope); the Mumbai/Tardeo address on the site is consistent with Maharashtra.
